name: Elizabeth I
hook: The Virgin Queen who beheaded a rival queen, scattered the Armada, and gave her name to an age.

facts.label: Anne Boleyn
facts.statement: Elizabeth I was the daughter of Henry VIII and his second wife, Anne Boleyn, who gave birth to her on September 7, 1533.

facts.label: the Virgin Queen
facts.statement: Elizabeth never married and was called the Virgin Queen; Virginia, an original colony, was named for her chastity.

facts.label: the last Tudor
facts.statement: Elizabeth I was the last Tudor monarch; the dynasty ruled England from Henry VII in 1485 until her death in 1603.

facts.label: the Spanish Armada
facts.statement: Elizabeth's England scattered the Spanish Armada; a medal she issued reads, "God breathed and they were scattered."

facts.label: Mary, Queen of Scots
facts.statement: Mary, Queen of Scots plotted to kill Elizabeth and was found out in 1586; Elizabeth signed her death warrant, and Mary was executed in 1587.

facts.label: Sir Francis Drake
facts.statement: Francis Drake circumnavigated the globe, was knighted by Elizabeth, and hosted her aboard his ship, the Golden Hind.

facts.label: The Faerie Queene
facts.statement: Edmund Spenser's The Faerie Queene casts Elizabeth as Belphoebe; Britten's opera Gloriana takes its title from the poem.
